_comment: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Every organization here is invented.
Names are fictional and the business numbers are deliberately invalid
(nine zeros plus a counter), so no row can collide with or be mistaken
for a real CRA registered charity. Every record carries synthetic: true,
which the loader refuses to override.
The field set mirrors what a CRA T3010 return actually exposes, so these
can be swapped for real registry lookups without changing the schema.
The spread is intentional: budget bands from 85k to 9.4m, four provinces,
three applicant types, and one org with no revenue filed, because a
scorer that only works on tidy mid-size charities is not finished.

orgs.name: Northern Reach Bursary Society
orgs.mission: Need-based bursaries for students from rural and remote communities who are the first in their family to attend post-secondary education.
orgs.beneficiaries: Rural secondary students, roughly 70 awards per year

orgs.name: Rivermouth Literacy Collective
orgs.mission: After-school tutoring and family literacy programs in neighbourhoods with low high-school completion rates.
orgs.beneficiaries: Children in grades 3 to 9 and their caregivers, about 900 participants

orgs.name: Harbour Lights Youth Mentors
orgs.mission: Volunteer-run mentoring that pairs working tradespeople with young people leaving the school system early.
orgs.beneficiaries: Youth aged 15 to 19, about 40 matched pairs

orgs.name: Lakeshore Polytechnic Foundation
orgs.mission: Fundraising and endowment management for a public polytechnic, including entrance awards and applied research chairs.

orgs.name: Trois-Vallees School Board
orgs.mission: Public school authority serving fourteen schools across three rural valleys, seeking supplementary funding for STEM and literacy intervention.

orgs.name: Prairie Newcomer Learning Hub
orgs.status: Incorporated nonprofit, not a registered charity
orgs.mission: Language and workforce readiness classes for newly arrived families, operating from a single leased site.
orgs.beneficiaries: Adult newcomers and their school-age children

orgs.name: Cedar County Reading Partners
orgs.mission: Volunteer reading tutors placed in Title I elementary schools across a three-county area.
orgs.beneficiaries: Elementary students reading below grade level, about 500 per year
